# GARUDA OS

> Sovereign AI Operating System & Autonomous Engineering Workforce engineered by Founder Praveen Mahawar. High-velocity production execution for SaaS MVPs, Multi-Rail Fintech Gateways, Progressive Web Apps (PWA), and Autonomous AI Swarms.

## Overview
GARUDA OS is an autonomous software engineering and AI orchestration platform. Unlike traditional IT consulting or generic software agencies, GARUDA deploys deterministic, pre-verified engineering blueprints to eliminate technical debt, speed up go-to-market execution, and solve critical business revenue leaks within 48 to 72 hours.
